method.input: Native CDP touch contacts only; at most two contacts, normalized CSS coordinates; no keyboard/mouse
method.environment: Mobile Chromium emulation with software WebGL fallback
method.assistance: Driver captures live view then pauses after each batch. Screenshots inspected between batches. Synthetic gestures and pause-assisted decisions substantially reduce time pressure; not a continuous human phone session.
scope_limits: Not physical-phone, Safari, hardware FPS, audio, or human enjoyment certification
No runtime, helper, tests, settings, historical docs or existing evidence edited

outcome.stats_visibility_note: Mission statistics were returned as terminal UI DOM text by the driver; the actual terminal screenshot shows loss title and buttons but clips the statistics. The two recoveries and elimination were independently seen in earlier live HUD screenshots.
outcome.mission_duration_note: 00:55 is in-game time; wall duration includes pauses and screenshot inspection. No replay or arranged death.

rating_scale.definition: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 10 exceptionally clear and effective within observed coverage. Subjective provisional mobile usability assessment, not benchmark scores.

overall_mobile.definition: Combined practical touch playability and clarity
overall_mobile.reason: Movement, firing, reload, dash and two recoveries worked; atmosphere and feedback are strong. Precision aiming and reading threat/navigation feedback while routing around cover were difficult, even with pauses.

controls.definition: Touch reach, aiming, simultaneous actions and response
controls.reason: Two-thumb movement plus fire and drag works; hold-use and dash registered. Small fire-drag changes required repeated correction and missed moving targets. Multiple closely packed right-side buttons compete with look space.

gameplay.definition: Observed combat, traversal and objective interactions
gameplay.reason: Useful cover, regeneration, receiver healing and phase-break feedback create choices. Recovered two objectives while under pressure; failed to control multiple threats on the third approach. Later encounter quality is unassessed.

presentation.definition: Observed visual atmosphere and interface coherence
presentation.reason: Rain, reflective surfaces, cyan signage and restrained menu style form a coherent station atmosphere. No obvious rendering failure in viewed frames; software fallback and audio limits apply.

usability.reason: Briefing scroll, map and precise outside-reach prompt were useful. Wall/cover navigation near East Archive consumed corrections under fire. Mobile briefing still includes keyboard-specific map advice.

readability.definition: Legibility and visual prioritization at 844x390 CSS pixels
readability.reason: Health, ammo and major objective labels are clear. Tiny compass/timer/threat text and layered receiver/combat prompts require deliberate reading; terminal panel clips statistics in the inspected viewport.

observed_coverage: Menu, mission briefing and native menu scrolling; touch handbook opening
One fresh entry; induction guard elimination
Proportional movement/strafe, right-side look, simultaneous fire-drag and movement
Rifle magazine depletion and manual reload
Jump input during traversal; successful vault not established
Dash inputs and visible PHASE BREAK / SHOT CANCELED feedback
West receiver reach correction and HOLD USE recovery
Heart receiver HOLD USE recovery and visible health restoration
Map overview showing recovered and remaining objectives
East Archive approach, collisions/routing corrections, incoming fire and death
Actual terminal loss UI; no restart
failed_interactions_and_recoveries: Initial return-fire batches missed; shots and misses retained (terminal UI text reports 5% accuracy).
East approach met a wall/partition; backed off, strafed and turned to locate receiver, taking damage. Final hold-use attempt failed before third recovery.

After map capture the driver had automatically returned to paused phase; #close-map was rejected as not visible (sequence 20). Reopened map once, then resumed ordinary movement. Treat this as driver pause-workflow friction, not a proven game close-map defect.
One look drag at y=0.5 did not change heading; a later y=0.4 drag worked. Cause uncertain, potentially UI overlap; preserved in action log.

unresolved_actionable_issues.observation: Precision aim on moving sentinels was hard to correct with fire-drag; right thumb area is crowded by a three-column control cluster.
unresolved_actionable_issues.suggestion: Evaluate touch sensitivity options and clearer separation of free-look versus action-button hit regions on a real phone.
unresolved_actionable_issues.uncertainty: Synthetic discrete drags and reviewer skill contribute; not a proven input defect.

unresolved_actionable_issues.observation: Receiver direction points through opaque geometry at East Archive; approaching it led into a partition and required several corrections while taking fire.
unresolved_actionable_issues.suggestion: Make nearby doorway/approach guidance more distinct from the direct receiver beacon.
unresolved_actionable_issues.uncertainty: Map and ordinary alternate approaches may mitigate this; only one route attempted.

unresolved_actionable_issues.observation: Small secondary HUD labels and overlapping interaction/threat readouts require pause-assisted scrutiny at this viewport.
unresolved_actionable_issues.suggestion: Increase secondary text size or prioritize one prompt when interaction and combat cues coincide.

unresolved_actionable_issues.observation: Mission briefing references pressing M despite the mobile MAP control.
unresolved_actionable_issues.suggestion: Use input-specific wording in the briefing.

unresolved_actionable_issues.observation: The loss screenshot shows heading and restart/navigation buttons but omits terminal statistics present in UI text.
unresolved_actionable_issues.suggestion: Ensure statistics remain visibly accessible in the short landscape layout.
unresolved_actionable_issues.uncertainty: No terminal scrolling attempted because the review stopped promptly after loss; accessibility via scroll is unassessed.

evidence.retention: All captures and exact input batches retained; no overwritten captures. Sequence 20 command failure retained in log.

cleanup.conclusion: Both exact owned PIDs absent after awaited process exit. No global kill or unrelated process touched.
